full_zh: 背景：一位 PM 通过正式 help 流程升级：澳洲商户看不到 Amex 退款费。这个问题在三个团队之间弹了约 50 条回复，最后作为熟悉该领域的人被路由到我。
问题：线程里大家在争是谁的问题，没人拿出一份所有人都能核对的证据。我 own 的是答案，不是工单。
我做了什么：我不查组织架构，直接拉数据。六个月内按国家统计退款费行数：美国约 108 万行、英国 294 行、澳洲 0 行，涉及约 150 个澳洲商户。根因在配置：所有澳洲商户的 fee_refund_policy 都是 partial，而退款费逻辑只在 full 时触发。我还证明了这早于平台迁移，不是我们引入的回归。
结果：我把结论连同原始查询写出来，让 PM 和另一个团队自己复跑，线程当天结束，并转成一张正式的功能票，要在 Snowglobe 里建 REFUND_FEE 计算管线。线程里还冒出第二个不相关的费用种类，我如实说 not sure yet，给出分层假设，资深同事确认了。
为什么这样做 / 学到：当分歧其实来自知识不对称，就给所有人同一份证据，不争归属。宁可说 not sure yet 并给出计划，也不乱猜。
full_en: A product manager escalated through our formal help process: Australian merchants weren't seeing Amex refund fees. It bounced across three teams for about fifty replies before it was routed to me as the person who knows that domain. I pulled the data instead of the org chart. Over six months there were more than a million refund-fee rows in the US and zero in Australia, across about a hundred and fifty merchants. The root cause was configuration, not code: every Australian merchant's pricing schedule had the refund policy set to partial, and the refund-fee logic only fires on full. I also showed it predated our platform migration, so it wasn't a regression we introduced. I wrote it up with the exact query so the PM and the other team could re-run it themselves. It ended the thread the same day and became a tracked feature to build the refund-fee pipeline properly. In the same thread a second, unrelated fee kind came up; I said I wasn't sure, laid out a layered hypothesis, and a senior engineer confirmed it. I'd rather say 'not sure yet' with a plan than guess.

full.example: The thread was routed to me as the person who knows that domain.
One query cut through fifty replies of noise and put everyone on the same facts.
I showed the behavior predates the migration, so it wasn't a regression we introduced.

hook.zh: 上百万行对零行（反差本身就是证据）
hook.example: More than a million refund-fee rows in the US versus zero in Australia made the gap undeniable.
The thread bounced around three teams for about fifty replies.
Sharing the query ended the thread the same day.

starl.example: I pulled the data by country instead of arguing about whose code it was.
I attached the exact query so the finding was reproducible by anyone.
The root cause was configuration, not code: the refund policy was partial.

followups.zh: 分层假设（逐层列出可能原因及验证方式）
followups.example: For the second fee kind I offered a layered hypothesis and how to verify each layer.
I'd rather say not sure yet with a plan than guess.

followups.zh: 回归（以前没问题，改动后才出错）
followups.example: I proved it was not a regression, because the payout service never issued those fees.

relp.zh: 对答案全权负责的单一责任人
relp.example: It wasn't my ticket, but I became the single-threaded owner of the answer.
I earned trust with transparency by giving the other team the raw query.
I worked backwards from the Australian merchants, who were missing fees they should receive.

senior.q: How would you tell the merchants and the PM what to expect while the feature is being built?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你在给出根因之后，有没有照顾到客户的实际等待与预期管理。
framework: 先说结论：这是配置与功能缺失，不是临时故障，不会自己恢复
再说时间：功能票的 owner 和排期要明确，没有排期就如实说没有
再说过渡：有没有手工修复或临时补偿，没有就说明没有
最后说沟通节奏：有进展就同步，没进展也定期告知
senior.best_practice: 客户最怕的是不知道结果，所以先说清是什么问题、是否会自己好、什么时候有下一步。没有补偿就如实说没有，比含糊其辞更能保住信任。我这里没有补偿数字，所以说的是方法而不是承诺。

terms.example: I would set expectations that this is a missing feature, not a transient failure.
I would close the loop with the PM once the feature ticket has an owner and a date.

senior.q: How would you size the money that Australian merchants did not receive?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你能否把一个配置问题换算成业务影响，帮助排优先级。
framework: 先取量：澳洲 non-agg Amex 销售笔数约 288 万，涉及退款的子集
再取费率：用美国同类退款费的平均值作参照，并说明这是估算
再给区间：给一个范围，而不是单点数字，标出假设
最后用途：给功能票排优先级，不当作账面金额
senior.best_practice: 估算金额的目的是让 owner 能排优先级，所以给出范围和假设比给一个看起来精确的数字更诚实。我手上没有这个金额，所以我会把它标成待估算，而不是编一个数。

terms.example: I would do a back-of-the-envelope estimate using US refund-fee rates as a reference.
I would state the assumptions so the range can be challenged.

senior.q: How would you make sure the next cross-team escalation of this kind does not take fifty replies?
senior.why: 面试官在探：你能否把一次救火变成可自助的机制。
framework: 先说沉淀：把按国家和配置拉数的查询保存成可复用的看板或 runbook
再说入口：帮助流程里加一条先自查的清单，附上这类查询
再说路由：把有领域知识的人更早地挂进线程
最后说衡量：看同类升级的回复数和解决时长是否下降
senior.best_practice: 一次靠个人解决的问题，只有变成别人也能自助的东西才真正解决了。把查询存下来、前移到入口，是为了让下一次不需要等到第 50 条回复。用回复数和解决时长衡量，能说明改进是否有效。

terms.example: I would make the country-level query self-serve so the next PM can check it alone.
I would shift the check left into the help form instead of waiting for a fifty-reply thread.

senior.q: What would you do if the data had contradicted your guess, and a senior stakeholder insisted on the original theory?
senior.why: 面试官在探：证据与权威冲突时，你是否仍然以证据为准，同时保持尊重。
framework: 先说立场：结论由查询给出，不由我给出，数据不支持我就改结论
再说沟通：把查询和结果原样给对方，请对方指出查询哪里不对
再说升级：如果仍有分歧，约一次短会一起过查询，而不是在线程里继续争
最后说态度：对事不对人，也不拿对方的职级当论据
senior.best_practice: 让证据而不是职级决定结论，需要双方都能复核同一份查询。请对方挑查询的错，把争论变成技术问题，既尊重对方，又不放弃事实。如果真是我错了，立刻改，这样别人才会信任我下次的数据。

terms.example: If the data contradicted my guess, I would let the data decide and change my conclusion.
I would disagree respectfully by asking the stakeholder to find the flaw in the query.
